about: The limits of tools/ci/perf.mjs. Each benchmark of tests/bench/perf-map.json has its own threshold, the relative growth of its median that counts as a regression. The growth must also be more than `mads` times the larger median absolute deviation of the two measurements, which is at least `floor` (seconds for time, bytes for memory). `ratio` is the threshold of a benchmark that the perf map gives none. A benchmark marked short runs `short_factor` times as many rounds. `skip` lists ids that CI never runs.
